purpose: Engine/propulsion enrichment scoped by brand + model + generation

fields.engineCode: nullable; never infer from marketing name

rules: Never select an engine code unless explicitly present in verified data.
Do not infer engine variant from displacement alone when multiple power variants exist.
Year is a consistency signal, not sole authority.
Unknown engine text remains unresolved and must not block request creation.
Engine enrichment is non-destructive and must not overwrite EXPLICIT subject fields.
